name: pumi-launcher
description: A tab that lists what you can open in it: a file, and whatever your plugins add to the + menu (a terminal, a page, an agent…). Pick one and it takes the tab's place. Set it as what new tabs open, and every new tab, split and session starts with the list.

images.alt: A new tab as the list of what it can open: a file, a terminal, a page, an agent, each with its key
